title: Holiday House
meta_description: Holiday House is a 3BR Sunrise Beach cottage with private beach access, screened porch, ocean views, bikes, game room, and walk to 30A restaurants.
description_expanded:
Holiday House is located just across from the beach boardwalk in the private gated community of Sunrise Beach.

ABOUT THIS HOME: Every day feels like a holiday when you wake up in this newly remodeled cottage by the sea. Holiday House is located in the private gated beach-front community of Sunrise Beach, between Blue Mountain and Gulf Place. This lovely 3 bedroom coastal home is perfect for entertaining and relaxing. After your day in the sun, enjoy your evenings on the screened in porch. No need to leave the house to watch the sunsets; you can do that from the top floor loft. You'll be amazed by nature's beauty.

ABOUT THE AREA: Some of 30A's best restaurants are located within walking distance to the Holiday House. Walk to the famous oysters at Shunk Gulley or their beignet fries for watching the sun set. Blue Mountain Bakery and the Perfect Pig are great options to get your day started. After breakfast, hop on the bikes and explore 30A. There are 4 State Parks along this stretch of land and they are worth exploring. Their beaches are amazing too.

BEACH ACCESS: This lovely home has their own private beach access and it's just steps away. When you exit the home there is a pathway access in the corner to your left. You can take the stairs all the way down to the beautiful turquoise water and soft white sand! This home includes a beach set up of chairs and umbrella.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - 1 King, ensuite -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 Queen, ensuite -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 3 - 2 Full/Full Bunk beds -- 1st Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 2 Bikes
• Ocean Views
• Grill -- Propane
• Wrap around, screened in porch with daybed porch swing
• Game room/ Veranda
• Smart TVs
• Coffee Maker -- pod
• Pets Considered
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Pets may be allowed with prior approval. Please contact us before booking to discuss your request.

Parking Details:
- This property has 3 parking spaces with no overflow parking available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
